summary: Tested SIM binding independently through the API (new pytest file, 13 tests: 11 pass, 2 fail on real bugs), DB inspection, a regression probe for a chat-blocked user, and Playwright UI runs at 390x844 on /profile, /verify-sim, /link-device, /admin/sim-binding and chat send while blocked. These all work: the core rule (a SIM_PRESENT check sets sim_presence and never sets number_verified, even when the client injects number_verified or level), nonce hardening (forged, unknown, cross-account, expired, web/WEB, unknown state and replay all return 400), number-proof returning 503 and staying unverified, the disclaimer, revalidate, the SIM-change wipe, link-code single use, expiry, cross-account refusal and the unverified-phone refusal, the admin-only checks and the policy clamp, and privacy (no identifier fields in sim_bindings, no nonce or link code in sim_audit). Chat REQUEST, THREADS, MESSAGES and contact-support writes return 403 with code=sim_verification_required and a plain-language message; GET threads, messages and starred return 200 while blocked. All 14 non-chat endpoints checked return 200 for a blocked buyer, a blocked vendor and an admin; checkout is not gated (it reached the normal out_of_delivery_zone 400, so no test order was created). FAILURES: (1) A web link (web_link_expires_at, account-wide, 24h) overrides SIM_ABSENT, revalidate_required and SIM change in chat_gate. Main agent's own suite had left this field on testbuyer, which silently bypassed the whole gate until I cleared it. (2) Some chat writes skip the gate: PATCH /chat/messages/{id} (edit) and POST /products/{pid}/questions (copied into the customer-vendor chat) both return 200 while blocked. (3) Device linking does nothing in practice, because verification is per account, not per device or session. The web /link-device screen shows 'This browser is linked' about 4s after minting a code, with no phone scan. (4) On web, a blocked chat send shows NOTHING: RN Alert.alert does nothing on web, so the 403 is swallowed and the draft is silently put back. (5) There is no device attestation, so any logged-in client can POST SIM_PRESENT with platform=android. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch). The Kotlin module reads only simState, the active subscription list, isEmbedded, mcc/mnc and roaming; subscriptionId is used locally and never sent.

critical.issue: Once a device-link is claimed, binding.web_link_expires_at lets EVERY chat write through for 24h, even after the phone reports SIM_ABSENT, after /revalidate, or after a SIM change. Reproduced: claim link, then verify SIM_ABSENT, then POST /chat/contact-support returns 200. Reproduced again: revalidate, then contact-support returns 200 while a link is present. record_device_check and require_revalidation never clear the link. Fix: honour the web link only when the phone's own binding meets the requirement right now (compute_level of the binding without the link), and $unset web_link_expires_at in record_device_check when sim_state != SIM_PRESENT or changed, and in require_revalidation.

Chat writes that skip the gate. While SIM_ABSENT: editing your own message returns 200, so a blocked user can rewrite old messages with any new content. Product questions return 200, and that route copies the question into a customer-vendor chat_threads/chat_messages pair (products_extended.py ~L135-180). Also not gated (code review): POST /chat/request/{id}/accept and POST /orders/{id}/chat-vendor (cart.py L562) both create threads. Add await _assert_sim_verified(user) to edit and accept. Skip the chat copy (or gate it) in ask_question, and gate chat-vendor.

Verification level is ACCOUNT-wide, not bound to a device or session (sid). Any session of a user who once posted SIM_PRESENT, including a browser that never linked, passes the gate, so allow_web_without_link=false has no effect and linking adds nothing. The web link also gives the 'linked' level to the whole account, not to the browser that showed the QR. Fix: store verification per session sid (or per device_fp), have claim mark the browser's sid (the start doc should record the browser's sid), and have the gate check the caller's sid.

No device attestation. The nonce stops replay but not forgery: any logged-in script can fetch a challenge and POST sim_state=SIM_PRESENT, platform=android, and get sim_presence. is_device is trusted from the client and never used. This conflicts with the brief's 'reject client requests that merely claim success'. Recommend a Play Integrity token that carries the challenge nonce, verified server-side before accepting SIM_PRESENT; until then, document that sim_presence can be spoofed with curl.

minor.issue: Policy key is stored and patchable but never read by chat_gate (dead config, so the admin toggle would be a no-op).

SIM_ABSENT is fingerprinted with empty mcc/mnc and 0 slots, so taking out and putting back the SAME SIM sets sim_changed=true and revalidate_required. One extra check is needed, which auto-runs on foreground, so this is low impact.
The policy_updated audit records only key names (plus updated_at and updated_by), not old/new values, so the admin event tail can't show who turned enforcement OFF versus ON.

ui_bugs.issue: The browser shows 'This browser is linked' about 4s after 'Show link code' with NO phone scan (confirmed in UI). The poll checks account-wide status.meets_requirement, which is already true for any account with a SIM check. It should poll that specific code's claimed status (e.g. GET /sim-binding/device-link/{code}).

Uses RN Alert.alert, which does nothing on react-native-web. On web a blocked send gets a 403 but the user sees no message and no 'Verify now'; the draft is silently put back (confirmed in UI). Use notify() from src/notify.ts, which falls back to window.confirm. Better still, show an inline banner above the composer with a Verify now button.

ui_bugs.component: app/(tabs)/chat.tsx onSendRequest / onAcceptRequest, app/services/[id].tsx start chat
ui_bugs.issue: These entry points also use Alert.alert, which does nothing on web. They have no special handling for sim_verification_required and no 'Verify now' route, so a blocked user gets no explanation at these points.
Reachable when logged out. /link-device shows a raw 'Not authenticated' error after 'Show link code' instead of redirecting to login.

integration_issues.issue: Linking the browser by QR gives no real authorisation: the backend gate is per account, and the UI declares the browser linked without any claim.

issues: Before status loads, the screen shows 'SIM status unclear… Try again in a moment' and 'Number not confirmed' (default SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN) instead of a loading state.
On the website it says 'SIM detected — A SIM or eSIM is active in this phone', copied from the phone's account-level reading, which is confusing on a desktop.
The 'Require verification for chat' switch turns enforcement off for every user in one tap, with no confirmation.

react_native_issues.issue: The chat gate's error handling uses RN Alert.alert, which does nothing on react-native-web, so the SIM message never shows on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:320

action_items: CRITICAL: chat_gate must not let web_link_expires_at override SIM_ABSENT, revalidate_required or a SIM change. Clear the link in record_device_check (state != SIM_PRESENT or changed) and in require_revalidation.
Gate the remaining chat writes: PATCH /chat/messages/{id}, POST /chat/request/{id}/accept, POST /orders/{id}/chat-vendor, and the chat copy in POST /products/{pid}/questions.
Bind verification to the session (sid) or device so web sessions need an actual link claim. Make link-device poll that code's claim status, not meets_requirement.
Replace Alert.alert with notify() in the chat/[id].tsx send handler, and add sim_verification_required handling with a 'Verify now' route in (tabs)/chat.tsx and services/[id].tsx.
Add a Play Integrity check bound to the challenge nonce (or clearly document that sim_presence is spoofable).
Either wire block_on_sim_absent into chat_gate or remove it.
verify-sim: show a loading state while status is null, and use web-specific copy.
Fix the test hygiene in test_sim_binding.py: it leaves web_link_expires_at on testbuyer, which hides every gate regression for 24h.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/chat.py is 1300 lines; split it (threads, messages, requests, ws).
core/sim_binding.py and routes/chat.py keep 'from __future__ import annotations'. That is fine there because neither router uses @limiter.limit, but the note says it breaks limiter routes.
device_link_start does not record the browser's sid or user-agent, so nothing ties the claim back to that browser.
admin_overview returns the last 40 audit rows including ip/ua with no masking. Acceptable for admins, but note it for DPDP.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/verify-sim.tsx (testIDs added: verify-sim-back, verify-sim-check-button, verify-sim-link-device-button, verify-sim-open-settings, verify-sim-state-title, verify-sim-number-title, verify-sim-disclaimer)

Use tests/iter103_set_sim_state.py SIM_ABSENT|SIM_PRESENT to toggle the block through the real challenge->verify path. The support thread for testbuyer is 671aefb5-4613-4dfd-afcd-b46e92b819f5. rca_of_issue: Gate bypass RCA: chat_gate checks status_for(user) (account-level) first, then returns allowed=True if binding.web_link_expires_at is in the future, without re-checking sim_state or revalidate_required. The link is written onto the same per-user binding doc and is never cleared by record_device_check or require_revalidation. Repro: (1) verify SIM_PRESENT, (2) device-link/start then claim, (3) verify SIM_ABSENT, (4) POST /chat/contact-support returns 200 (expected 403). The false 'linked' message on web has the same root cause: per-account state is used as if it were per-device.
